license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person who does not hold an active, unexpired license issued pursuant to this article, or who is not practicing pursuant to the licensure exceptions set forth in this section, to: (1) Engage in the practice of medicine and surgery or podiatry in this state

issuing_authority.quote: The board remains the sole authority for the issuance of licenses to practice medicine and surgery, to practice podiatry, and to practice as physician assistants in this state

name.quote: The board remains the sole authority for the issuance of licenses to practice medicine and surgery, to practice podiatry, and to practice as physician assistants in this state

type.quote: The board shall consist of 15 members. One member shall be the state health officer ex officio, with the right to vote as a member of the board. The other 14 members shall be appointed by the Governor, with the advice and consent of the Senate. Eight of the members shall be appointed from among individuals holding the degree of doctor of medicine, and one shall hold the degree of doctor of podiatric medicine.

interval_years.quote: A license to practice medicine and surgery or podiatry in this state is valid for a term of two years.

available.quote: Any person seeking to be licensed to practice podiatry in this state who holds a valid license to practice podiatry attained under requirements similar to the requirements in 30-3-10 of this code from another jurisdiction shall be issued a license to practice podiatry, as appropriate, in this state

requirements.value: Must hold a valid license from another jurisdiction obtained under requirements similar to WV requirements; must submit application, pay licensure fee, demonstrate requisite qualifications to provide same standard of care as a WV-licensed podiatrist, and disclose any past disciplinary actions.
requirements.quote: He or she must submit an application to the board on forms provided by the board and remit a licensure fee, as provided in legislative rule ... He or she must demonstrate to the satisfaction of the board that he or she has the requisite qualifications to provide the same standard of care as a physician or podiatrist initially licensed in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to obtain or renew a license by bribery, fraudulent misrepresentation, or through board error
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to obtain, obtaining, renewing, or attempting to renew a license or other authorization to practice medicine and surgery or podiatry by bribery, fraudulent misrepresentation, or through known error of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being found guilty of a felony, crime involving moral turpitude, or crime directly relating to the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being found guilty of a crime in any jurisdiction, which offense is a felony, involves moral turpitude, or directly relates to the practice of medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in false or deceptive advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: False or deceptive advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unauthorized person to practice podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unauthorized person to practice medicine and surgery or podiatry contrary to law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a false report or intentionally failing to file required reports
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report that the person knows to be false; intentionally or negligently failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Requesting, receiving, or paying unlawful referral fees for patients or health care services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Requesting, receiving, or paying directly or indirectly a payment, rebate, refund, commission, credit, or other form of profit or valuable consideration for the referral of patients to any person or entity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Referring patients to a lab or pharmacy in which the podiatrist has an undisclosed proprietary interest
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct by any physician or podiatrist in referring a patient to any clinical laboratory or pharmacy in which the physician or podiatrist has a proprietary interest unless the physician or podiatrist discloses in writing such interest to the patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exercising influence within the patient-physician relationship for sexual activity or engaging in other sexual misconduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exercising influence within a patient-physician relationship for the purpose of engaging a patient in sexual activity or engaging in other sexual misconduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representation in the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representation in the practice of medicine and surgery or podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting patients through fraud, intimidation, or undue influence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting patients, either personally or by an agent, through the use of fraud, intimidation, or undue influence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep written records justifying the course of treatment of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to keep written records justifying the course of treatment of a patient, including, but not limited to, patient histories, examination and test results, and treatment rendered, if any

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exercising influence on a patient so as to exploit the patient for financial gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exercising influence on a patient in such a way as to exploit the patient for financial gain of the physician or podiatrist or of a third party.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or administering a controlled substance outside of good-faith therapeutic practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, administering, mixing, or otherwise preparing a prescription drug, including any controlled substance under state or federal law, other than in good-faith and in a therapeutic manner in accordance with accepted medical standards and in the course of the physicians or podiatrists professional practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing experimental procedures on human subjects without full informed written consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any procedure or prescribing any therapy that, by the accepted standards of medical practice in the community, would constitute experimentation on human subjects without first obtaining full, informed, and written consent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or accepting responsibilities the person is not competent to perform
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or accepting and performing professional responsibilities that the person knows or has reason to know he or she is not competent to perform

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person not qualified by training, experience, or licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person when the physician or podiatrist delegating the responsibilities knows or has reason to know that the person is not qualified by training, experience, or licensure to perform them

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the article or a rule or order of the board, or failing to comply with a subpoena
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of this article or a rule or order of the board or failing to comply with a subpoena or subpoena duces tecum issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conspiring to coerce, intimidate, or preclude another podiatrist from lawfully advertising services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conspiring with any other person to commit an act or committing an act that would tend to coerce, intimidate, or preclude another physician or podiatrist from lawfully advertising his or her services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in the use and control of prescription forms
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence in the use and control of prescription forms

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to physical or mental impairment, including drug or alcohol abuse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The inability to practice medicine and surgery or podiatry with reasonable skill and safety due to physical or mental impairment, including deterioration through the aging process, loss of motor skill, or abuse of drugs or alcohol.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly failing to report gross misconduct by another board licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly failing to report to the board any act of gross misconduct committed by another licensee of the board or failing to comply with any reporting requirement set forth in 30-3-14(b) of this code.

definition_quote.value: Practice of podiatry means the examination, diagnosis, treatment, prevention and care of conditions and functions of the human foot and ankle by medical, surgical and other scientific knowledge and methods; with surgical treatment of the ankle authorized only when a podiatrist has been granted privileges to perform ankle surgery by a hospital's medical staff credentialing committee based on the training and experience of the podiatrist; and medical and surgical treatment of warts and other dermatological lesions of the hand which similarly occur in the foot.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of podiatry" means the examination, diagnosis, treatment, prevention and care of conditions and functions of the human foot and ankle by medical, surgical and other scientific knowledge and methods; with surgical treatment of the ankle authorized only when a podiatrist has been granted privileges to perform ankle surgery by a hospital's medical staff credentialing committee based on the training and experience of the podiatrist; and medical and surgical treatment of warts and other dermatological lesions of the hand which similarly occur in the foot.

methods_authorized.quote: the examination, diagnosis, treatment, prevention and care of conditions and functions of the human foot and ankle by medical, surgical and other scientific knowledge and methods

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists may prescribe controlled substances in good faith and in a therapeutic manner; telemedicine prescribing of Schedule II controlled substances is restricted. Prescribing outside good-faith therapeutic practice is a disciplinary ground.
drug_authority.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, administering, mixing, or otherwise preparing a prescription drug, including any controlled substance under state or federal law, other than in good-faith and in a therapeutic manner in accordance with accepted medical standards and in the course of the physicians or podiatrists professional practice

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the examination, diagnosis, treatment, prevention and care of conditions and functions of the human foot and ankle by medical, surgical and other scientific knowledge and methods

anesthesia_authority.quote: When a podiatrist uses other than local anesthesia, in surgical treatment of the foot, the anesthesia must be administered by, or under the direction of, an anesthesiologist or certified registered nurse anesthetist authorized under the State of West Virginia to administer anesthesia.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: with surgical treatment of the ankle authorized only when a podiatrist has been granted privileges to perform ankle surgery by a hospital's medical staff credentialing committee based on the training and experience of the podiatrist

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: with surgical treatment of the ankle authorized only when a podiatrist has been granted privileges to perform ankle surgery by a hospital's medical staff credentialing committee based on the training and experience of the podiatrist

telehealth_authorized.quote: A physician or podiatrist who practices telemedicine must be licensed as provided in this article or registered as provided in 30-1-1 et seq. of this code.

controlled_substances_prescribing_ce_req.quote: a person issued a license to practice podiatry or licensed as a physician assistant by the West Virginia Board of Medicine ... shall complete drug diversion training, best-practice prescribing of controlled substances training, and training on prescribing and administering an opioid antagonist if that person prescribes, administers, or dispenses a controlled substance
controlled_substances_prescribing_ce_req.citation: UMBRELLA / Article 1. General Provisions Applicable to All State Boards

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: a physician, podiatrist or physician assistant licensed, certified or otherwise lawfully practicing in this state or applying for a license to practice in this state may enter into a voluntary agreement with the physician health program

preoperative_history_and_physical_author.quote: A medical evaluation shall be made by a physician of every patient prior to the administration of other than local anesthesia.
